## Pre-Merge Checklist

If any of these checks are missing, please provide an explanation.

- [ ] I have updated README and CLAUDE.md files, if applicable.
- [ ] I have updated workflows, if applicable.
- [ ] Dependencies were added with `uv add` and `uv.lock` is committed.
- [ ] Only generated data is committed, never real data.
- [ ] I have run `make pre-pr` and all checks have passed.
- [ ] I have run `make run` and checked the change in the browser, if applicable.
